# proxmox_node_hosts (Resource)

Manages `/etc/hosts` of a node through `GET|POST /nodes/{node}/hosts`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_hosts" "h" {
  node = "pve-1"
  data = "127.0.0.1 localhost\n"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data` (String)
- `node` (String)

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
